schedule.description: Lines of the current Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) from one HTS number to another, in schedule order: htsno, indent, description, units, general (column 1 general / MFN), special (FTA and preference programs, with program codes), other (column 2), footnotes (chapter 99 references), quota. The pack adds the rate inherited by statistical (10-digit) lines, the rate type, a numeric ad valorem percent where the rate is Free or a plain percent, and the chapter 99 headings the footnotes point to.

from.desc: first HTS number, 4 to 10 digits with or without dots (e.g. "7208", "8703.80"); chapter 99 lines (additional duties: Sections 232, 301 and other actions) start at 9903

to.desc: last HTS number, including every line under it (from=8703, to=8703 returns the whole heading 8703); keep ranges to a few chapters per request

search.description: Keyword search of the current HTS (descriptions and HTS numbers), one row per matching line, in schedule order, with the same rate columns as schedule.

keyword.desc: a word, phrase or HTS number, e.g. "copper", "lithium-ion", "8507.60"

current_release.description: The HTS revision the API serves now (name, description, title), one row. Record it with every rate: the schedule changes several times a month.

releases.description: Every published HTS edition and revision since 2015 (name, description, date posted, status current or archive), newest first; about 185 rows.
